name: Hongkang Chu

children.text: I am a master's student at the University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, with research at the Innovation Academy for Precision Measurement Science and Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences. My work spans multimodal learning, synthetic image and video detection, and deep learning for magnetic resonance imaging and spectroscopy.

I collaborate with researchers at Zhejiang University on synthetic image and video detection and have worked remotely with UIUC on medical AI. Previously, I studied Computer Science and Technology at Shanghai Ocean University.
TRACE is available on arXiv and submitted to ICLR 2027.
ClueAegis was accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026.
Our weighted-average CSI work was selected for an ISMRM 2026 Power Pitch.
Our physics-embedded CycleGAN study is published online in Magnetic Resonance Letters.
Our NMR phase correction study is published in The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters.
My first-author work on druggable proteins was published in IJMS.
Research in MRI, MRSI, and deuterium metabolic imaging at the Innovation Academy for Precision Measurement Science and Technology.
Co-developed prior-informed deep learning reconstruction for weighted-average CSI, combining anatomical and spectral information; first-author ISMRM 2026 Power Pitch.
Co-authored work on physics-embedded CycleGAN reconstruction for short-readout deuterium metabolic imaging, published in Magnetic Resonance Letters.
Co-authored a phase model-driven deep learning study for NMR phase correction, published in The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters.

Second author of TRACE, studying generative-model velocity responses and temporal consistency for synthetic video detection; submitted to ICLR 2027.
Second author of ClueAegis, using perceptual clues, forensic skill selection, and evidence-guided reasoning for synthetic image detection; accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026.

TRACE: Trajectory Representation and Consistency Estimation for AI-Generated Video Detection

TRACE uses a pretrained Flow Matching video model to probe velocity responses in real and generated videos. It combines trajectory representations with cross-frame consistency to study detection across different video generators.
ClueAegis: Heuristic-to-Reasoning Cognitive-skill Learning for Unified Evidence-based Synthetic Image Detection

ClueAegis connects perceptual clues with forensic skill selection and tool-assisted reasoning. The framework produces structured evidence for synthetic image detection, with a benchmark organized around forensic cognitive skills.
Physics-embedded CycleGAN for robust metabolite mapping in short-readout deuterium metabolic imaging

This work embeds a bSSFP-DMI forward model in a CycleGAN to estimate metabolite and off-resonance maps from short-readout measurements. Unpaired training enforces signal consistency and reduces metabolite leakage in simulations and mouse experiments.
Phase Model-Driven Deep Learning for Robust Phase Correction in High-Throughput NMR-Based Metabolomics

A physically informed phase model guides a residual attention network for automated NMR phase correction. The study evaluates the method on metabolomics spectra, including brain extracts, plasma, and urine. Chuanwen Zhao is the first author.
The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters, 2026 · Published
Deep Learning Enhanced Weighted Average CSI for High-Resolution Deuterium Metabolic Imaging

Weighted-average CSI acquisition is combined with deep learning that uses anatomical and spectral priors to reconstruct deuterium metabolite maps. This first-author work was selected for the ISMRM 2026 Power Pitch session on AI Methods.
Comprehensive Research on Druggable Proteins: From PSSM to Pre-Trained Language Models

This study compares PSSM features and pretrained protein language models for druggable protein classification. It evaluates ESM-2 embeddings and an adapted GPT-2 classifier, with additional validation using Pharos.
